name: Mitsurugi Yuuhi
source:
Yuuhi and her sister Meiya are the heiresses of Mitsurugi group, one of the biggest and richest corporations on Earth.

One day Takeru wakes up to find the sisters in his bed and they declare that he is meant to be together with one of them.

Like her sister she also believes in the Bushido code, but unlike her she isn't that hotblooded to rush into every situation headfirst.

She has access to unlimited resources and overprotective attendants who try to help her win over Takeru. This puts her into the rival status with her sister over his love, but they decided to play it fair...
